narr: A slow moving thunderstorm moved over the Lewiston/Clarkston area and caused flash flooding. The KLWS ASOS recorded 0.68 inches of rain from 1250LST to 1356LST.
ev: Flash flooding impacted several roads of Clarkston. Half an inch of rain fell in 15 minutes from 1330LST to 1345LST. Flooding also impacted on State Highway 129 between Asotin and Clarkston, with mud and debris on the roadway.
lsr: Several reports and photos of flash flooding in the Clarkston Heights area. Time estimated from radar.
Several roads flooded and temporarily closed in Clarkston.
